opening.argument: The presentation actively solicits participation by promoting OneCoin packages, encouraging viewers to build a team, and tying rewards to the recruitment and activity of others. It describes a network bonus structure, including earnings connected to partner legs, while presenting token doubling as a benefit. Paid package levels determine how many tokens participants receive, and the speaker links buying a package to reselling coins and increasing capital several times over. These features combine recruitment-dependent compensation, paid token packages, and aggressive appreciation claims into a coordinated appeal to join the network and invest, rather than a neutral discussion of cryptocurrency. The central message is therefore a deceptive investment and recruitment solicitation.
